description: Na₂SnO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.80 Å. Sn is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.12 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Sn atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Sn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-5°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Sn atoms.
